title: Enphase Microinverter Offline Wave
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=enphase:production
| bin _time span=1h
| stats dc(eval(if(status="offline",inverter_serial,null()))) as offline_inverters by site _time
| where offline_inverters>1
| sort - offline_inverters
description: Uses Enphase production telemetry telemetry to monitor hours where multiple microinverters were offline together in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for site-wide inverter issues before they turn into yield loss, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Enphase production telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It records hours where multiple microinverters were offline together so you can spot site-wide inverter issues before they turn into yield loss before it becomes annoying.
